0.9.11.title: Fix Desktop Video Encoding & Sequence Preview Frame Drops (Stutter & Skip)
0.9.11.summary: Resolved video stuttering and frame drop issues on desktop. Fixed the refresh rate mismatch between source videos (24~30fps) and forced 60fps encoding by standardizing on 30fps CFR with 1:1 frame pacing, eliminating frame duplication and 16.6ms wall-clock race conditions. Also throttled React state updates during sequence preview to 12.5Hz while keeping canvas rendering at a smooth 60fps.

0.9.10.title: Enforce Zero Data Retention (ZDR) & Real-time Privacy Badges in Model Selector
0.9.10.summary: Enforces OpenRouter data_collection='deny' and zdr=true headers to prevent user video frames from being trained on. Introduces real-time privacy badges in the model selector indicating training policy and retention windows.

0.9.9.title: Allow Small Mobile Raw Video Blobs, Instant Download DB Sync & Dedicated Preserved Highlight Viewer
0.9.9.summary: Enables saving raw video blobs into IndexedDB for small mobile projects (up to 3 clips and 80MB), preventing missing file issues upon reopen. Guarantees immediate database synchronization right after export download so rendered files are 100% preserved even during abrupt browser exit. Replaced the empty upload dropzone and intrusive warning banners with an elegant preserved highlight viewer showcasing saved artwork, clip counts, and duration.

0.9.8.title: Add Default Sort by Filming Time in Settings & Auto-Order Clips on AI Highlight Generation
0.9.8.summary: Added a 'Default Sort by Filming Time' toggle option in Studio Settings, allowing clips to be automatically ordered chronologically (date, hour, minute, second) upon video import or AI highlight generation without needing to manually press the sort button every time. Preferences are permanently saved in local storage, and enabling the toggle immediately reorders existing timeline clips chronologically.

0.9.7.title: Prevent Background Browser Freezing (WakeLock & Keep-Alive) and Auto-Resume Stalled Analysis on Focus Return
0.9.7.summary: Completely resolves the issue where backgrounding Chrome or switching apps on mobile freezes the browser process or silently drops streaming sockets during long AI highlight generation. Integrates the Screen Wake Lock API, silent audio keep-alive, and Web Worker precision heartbeats to maintain active sockets in the background. Introduces a 25-second inactivity watchdog on AI Gateway streams. When returning to the app, it instantly detects stalled connections and auto-resumes progress seamlessly, saving intermediate checkpoints for each finished clip.

0.9.6.title: Preserve Stitched Final Video in IndexedDB on Mobile & Enable Instant 0s Playback & Download on Reopen
0.9.6.summary: Safely stores the single rendered final video blob in IndexedDB on mobile browsers, while leaving multi-gigabyte raw source clips unloaded to prevent WebKit memory crashes. When reopening the browser, users can immediately watch or download their finished video in 0 seconds without being asked to reconnect 18 raw files.

0.9.5.title: Add OPFS Virtual Filesystem & Browser Storage Purge Button in Settings
0.9.5.summary: Introduced a dedicated 'Clear Storage (Purge Cache)' button in Studio Settings to wipe orphaned OPFS temporary directories and browser CacheStorage. Addressed iOS native Photo Picker crashes where selecting 18+ high-res clips causes the picker sheet to abruptly dismiss due to iOS memory pressure.

0.9.4.title: Fix iPhone (iOS Safari) Mass Upload (18+) Video Decoder Exhaustion & WebProcess Reload Crash
0.9.4.summary: Resolved the Safari WebProcess Jetsam OOM reload crash when uploading 18+ video files on iPhone. Replaced heavy seeking video elements with a lightweight binary MP4/QuickTime mvhd/tkhd parser that extracts duration, resolution, and rotation in 0.05ms without decoder allocation. Mobile devices generate a thumbnail only for the first clip while bypassing decoder creation for remaining clips, complemented by 40ms GC pauses.

0.9.3.title: Fix Multi-Video Export Frame Drops on iPhone (iOS Safari) & 1:1 Decoder Frame Sync
0.9.3.summary: Eliminated severe frame drops and stuttering when exporting 18+ clips on iPhone by replacing synthetic wall-clock interpolation with strict requestVideoFrameCallback mediaTime synchronization, releasing DOM preview hardware decoder slots during export, and flushing decoder pipelines across clip switches.

0.9.2.title: Prevent iOS Safari Post-Upload Auto-Save & Metadata Parsing Memory Crashes
0.9.2.summary: Resolved an issue on iPhone XR and mobile Safari where the page crashed and reloaded shortly after uploading multiple videos due to background auto-save raw Blob serialization in IndexedDB/OPFS and duplicate multi-megabyte metadata buffer scans.

0.9.1.title: Multi-Video Memory & Decoder Optimization and Metadata/Performance Refinements
0.9.1.summary: Prevented Out-Of-Memory (OOM) crashes during large batch uploads, AI highlight analysis, and stitching on mobile and PC via immediate decoder cleanup, single canvas reuse, and audio buffer slicing, alongside enhanced date/GPS parsing and live model performance metrics.

0.9.0.title: Feedback & Improvement Board Integration & Patch Notes System
0.9.0.summary: Added integration with a feedback board for reporting issues or suggestions, along with patch notes to track changes across versions.

0.8.1.title: 1080p (FHD) & 720p Resolution Export Popup Integration
0.8.1.summary: Added a popup modal to select between 1080p FHD and 720p HD upon download, and cleaned up duplicate setting cards on the right.

0.8.0.title: Real-time WYSIWYG Sequence Compositor & BGM Speed Auto-Sync
0.8.0.summary: Drastically reduced export wait times with a CapCut-style real-time sequence preview compositor, automated BGM speed syncing, and fixed rendering frame stutter.

0.7.0.title: WebCodecs GPU Hardware-Accelerated 60fps Video Renderer
0.7.0.summary: Built a next-gen WebCodecs API hardware-accelerated 60fps renderer to dramatically boost stitching speed, with mobile 30fps optimization and Screen Wake Lock.

0.6.0.title: Clip Precision Trim Modal & High-Capacity OPFS Storage Roadmap
0.6.0.summary: Added precision trim modal for second-by-second clip adjustment, real-time sequence scrubbing, AI thumbnail auto-line-wrap, and browser OPFS large storage architecture.

0.5.1.title: Zero-Freeze Progress Engine & Responsive Zeno Asymptotic Interpolation
0.5.1.summary: Introduced a Zero-Freeze progress engine that prevents stalling during AI analysis, along with mobile Blob loss protection and auto playback URL recovery.

0.5.0.title: IndexedDB Studio Vault & Real-Time Auto-Save System
0.5.0.summary: Built a browser IndexedDB-based studio project vault ensuring active projects auto-save in real time and can be restored at any time.

0.4.1.title: AI Recommended Thumbnail Frame & NLE Multi-Track Timeline Sync
0.4.1.summary: AI automatically identifies and recommends the most dramatic frame as thumbnail, while resolving video V1 and audio A1 multi-track desync and stuttering.

0.4.0.title: HyperFrames Kinetic Chapter Bridge Motion Engine & GPS Reverse Geocoding
0.4.0.summary: Introduced a 5-stage kinetic louver wipe chapter transition engine powered by GSAP deterministic timelines, desktop clock date flips, and GPS reverse geocoded location mapping.

0.3.1.title: YouTube-Compatible SRT Subtitle Download & iOS Safari Playback Stabilization
0.3.1.summary: Added YouTube-compliant multilingual SRT subtitle downloads, workaround for WebKit Bug 212275, continuous canvas heartbeat, and iOS Safari hardware decoder pipeline stabilization.

0.3.0.title: YouTube Video Sharing Community Gallery & Supabase Database Integration
0.3.0.summary: Added a community gallery tab and Supabase DB integration to share finished highlights, along with a unified modern design system theme.

0.2.1.title: Multilingual Support (7 Locales) & Header/Model Selector Optimization
0.2.1.summary: Built an i18n system supporting 7 languages including English and Korean, improved the card-style AI vision model modal, and resolved iPhone segment stitching stalls.

0.2.0.title: NLE Multi-Track Studio & Complete Design Overhaul
0.2.0.summary: Built a Remotion-inspired Pro Studio Editor featuring NLE multi-track timelines, BGM synthesizer, and a clean, intuitive modern design system.

0.1.1.title: 16:9 YouTube Smart Crop & Real-time Inference Dashboard Improvements
0.1.1.summary: Improved 16:9 YouTube smart cropping alignment and upgraded the vision AI real-time inference dashboard pipeline.

0.1.0.title: Initial Launch of AI Dramatic Highlight Video Generator
0.1.0.summary: Initial release of the highlight generator leveraging OpenRouter multimodal vision models for multi-frame visual analysis and dramatic moment detection.
